summary: First-finish smoke tests for AccessLens. Backend health/root/analyze endpoints all functional with mock analyzer. Frontend full flow verified: navigation, upload, analyze, markers, results panel, filters, JSON download, multi-image, and camera dialog all work.
passed: POST /api/analyze (multipart image) -> 200 with id, filename, analyzed_at, summary, score(51), 3 findings each with id/x/y/severity/category/title/description/recommendation, source='mock', coords within 0-100
POST /api/analyze without image -> 422 (Pydantic missing field, acceptable 4xx)
POST /api/analyze with text file -> 400 {detail:'File must be an image'}
Homepage loads with header, logo, nav (home/about), hero CTAs, upload dropzone/browse/camera, footer
About page reachable via nav-about (/about route)
Upload via browse-file-input triggers thumbnail + image-canvas render
Analyze button triggers scanning-overlay, then 3 markers + 3 finding-cards render, results-panel visible, score='51/100'
filter-sev-high filter reduced visible cards from 3 to 1 correctly
Multi-image upload: 2 thumbnails present, clicking 2nd thumb switches active image
Camera dialog opens on upload-camera-btn and closes via camera-close-btn
